description:
Start adding a new email address. Sends an OTP code to the email. Returns a session ID: when the user has the code, pass it with that session ID to verify_email_otp (resend_email_otp if it did not arrive; get_add_email_status reads the session).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. Authenticating this client alone does NOT open this tool.
name: start_add_email

outputSchema.description: An email-add session: a code was emailed to the address

email_error.description: Why the code did not go out; present only when `email_sent` is false

email_sent.description: Whether the code went out; the session is started either way
